name: content-engine
description: LinkedIn content engine for B2B founders and their clients. From a person LinkedIn + company site: build a machine-readable LinkedIn strategy in Notion (ICP, voice profile, pillars, weekly rhythm), then run a weekly idea-recommendation loop, voice-true production with hook scoring and a grader, creatives, and a performance-tracking feedback cycle. Outputs to Notion in Ukrainian.

linkedin_li_at.title: LinkedIn li_at cookie
linkedin_li_at.description: LinkedIn session cookie (li_at). Used by cookie-based Apify actors to pull Sales Navigator lists (09-engage), own creator analytics with impressions (07-track, 08-repurpose), and full profile data. Optional — without it, lists fall back to a one-time CSV export and analytics to public engagement metrics.
